prior_round_ask_classification.R1-r2-ask-1-adr-amendment-rewrite: RESOLVED — re-derived by reading the rewritten amendment against the shipped code, not the commit message. The refuted 'exactly (a)(b)(c) ... EMPTY today' derivation and the 'explicit list' anti-drift paragraph are gone. The new text names the two conditional classes exactly as ComputeEntangleablePaths implements them (.gitignore via DispatchBead's EnsureGitignoreEntry, entry-absence-gated through the shared gitutil.HasGitignoreEntry check; the target spec's events.ndjson/manifest.json, recording.enabled-and-specID-gated), states the containment gate as the single source of truth ('a class is included iff its resolved absolute write target falls inside the canonical top-level of the invoking checkout's own git working tree'), explicitly renounces a second parallel resolution of 'where should this write have gone' (the SpecDir/custom-worktree_root divergence closed by construction), keeps the session.json/worktree-dir exclusions with the cfg.WorktreeRoot generalization, keeps the scope fence and notice paragraphs verbatim, and pins anti-drift to the test-injectable residual plus the three real-claim e2e fixtures (recording-enabled, gitignore-absent, custom worktree_root) — all three of which exist and pass.
prior_round_ask_classification.R1-r2-ask-2-guard-header-comments: RESOLVED — the false 'ALWAYS write under repoRoot / does NOT route through resolveAnchorRoot / gate on repoRoot == cwd' text is gone. Bullet 2 now correctly states the recording paths resolve through workspace.SpecDir (worktree-preferring), documents round-2 G2's non-cfg-aware-probe divergence and the trust-recording's-own-resolution rationale, and the containment paragraph describes the one mechanism the code actually implements (including WHY the old samePath gate was wrong in both directions). The SetEntangleableClaimPathsForTest comment I flagged (guard.go:69's stale 'the real enumeration is empty today') now reads 'independent of the two real, conditional dynamic classes'. Header and code now tell the same story.

rationale: Re-derived at 3018a659 and re-run by this reviewer in the bead worktree: build ok; internal/next + internal/gitutil + internal/lint -short green; ALL NINE cmd e2e claim-guard tests pass (740s, exit 0): the three round-3 additions (CustomWorktreeRootRecording, SubdirectoryInvocationRefusesByteIdentical, SymlinkAliasInvocationRefusesByteIdentical) plus every prior leg including the four-shape GitignoreVariantsRefuseByteIdentical (185s) and the three enumeration pins. Worktree left byte-identical (git status clean). The round-3 change is confined exactly where the commit says: a function-level diff of guard.go shows only the enumeration/containment region changed — samePath replaced by toplevelOf/containedRel/resolveContainingDirs, ComputeEntangleablePaths regated — while CheckDirtyTreeProportional, IgnoredDirtNotice, DirtyTreeFailure, and everything downstream are untouched from round 2, so the operator directive's notice contract, the refusal contract, and AC-16 (internal/approve untouched this round) all stand as previously verified. The containment redesign itself is sound from my lens: gitutil.Toplevel is a minimal, correctly-shaped wrapper (workdir via gitArgs, framework-authored flags, audit-table entry mirroring RevParseHEAD's justification); toplevelOf degrades to cwd-plus-EvalSymlinks on non-git dirs with a real reason documented (the macOS /var-vs-/private/var canonicalization trap); containedRel refuses escape ('..'-prefixed) instead of leaking relative paths and returns toplevel-relative slash-form matching porcelain's own convention — fixing the old rel-to-cwd base that was also wrong for subdirectory invocations. The disclosed leaf-symlink bonus fix (resolveContainingDirs) is judged CORRECT and necessary, not scope creep: git status reports a symlinked leaf under its OWN tracked name, so resolving only the ancestor directory chain (walking to the nearest existing ancestor, preserving not-yet-created recording dirs, degrading to the raw path at filesystem root) normalizes symlink ALIASES of the observed tree — the function's actual job — while keeping the leaf name porcelain-matchable; without it, the round-1 symlinked-.gitignore refusal fixture would silently un-entangle. It is pinned by TestContainedRel_SymlinkLeafKeepsOwnTrackedName and proven end-to-end by GitignoreVariantsRefuseByteIdentical staying green. The suffix-rejoin loop reassembles ancestor components in correct order (verified by reading and by the nested-nonexistent-path unit test). The lint table gains the one Toplevel entry; the composition-allowlist change is whitespace realignment only. All seven changed files map to the disclosed resolutions plus this one disclosed bonus. Both of my round-2 asks are delivered in substance and in letter; no findings remain from my lens.
